label: Origin-determined access and a world with no individuals give worldwise deletion
meaning: Conditional entailment, composed from originDeletion: a world with no individuals shares none with any world, so by the OPEN if-half of origin-determined access it is accessible from every world and deletion holds everywhere. With accessibleDeletionExcluded, origin-determined access, an empty possible world and Arrival A's presence-to-existence, inert emptiness and possible contingent-free past are jointly inconsistent. So the encoded origin-tolerance rival survives Arrival A only if it denies an empty possible world or rejects the if-half; the encoded commitments themselves neither assert nor exclude an empty world (OriginDeletion.Control.withEmpty has one; faithful has none, group 1 of OriginDeletion.Control.Certificate).
